title: Tiny Biotech Rallybio Stock Surges As $500 Million-Backed Merger Fuels Investor Optimism
author: Vandana Singh
description: Rallybio Corporation announced a merger agreement with Candid Therapeutics Inc., which has secured over $505 million in financing. The combined company will have approximately $700 million in pro-forma cash to support operations through 2030 and advance T-cell engager therapeutics for autoimmune diseases. Rallybio shares surged 29.05% to $9.73, reaching a new 52-week high. The transaction is expected to close in mid-2026, with the combined entity operating under the name Candid Therapeutics and trading under ticker 'CDRX'.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock surged 29.05% to a new 52-week high following the announcement of a merger with well-funded Candid Therapeutics. The combined entity will have strong financial backing ($700 million pro-forma cash) to advance multiple clinical programs through 2030, demonstrating investor confidence in the merger's strategic value.
